conviction_note: The Q1 短信 makes a beat of the company's H1 plan close to certain: the plan implies Q2 経常 of 2,482m, 36% below Q1's 3,908m, against a 185.6bn backlog up 57% and Q1 orders of 99.8bn. But the IFIS consensus (H1 7,100m, FY 14,200m against the company's 6,390m and 13,600m) has already priced that beat, so the only thing left to surprise is whether the full-year raise goes past 14.2bn, which would mean lifting H2 above its unchanged 7,210m despite the company's own warning about customer pull-forward. That gives a small positive lean (p_up 56 on abs 4.0 = +0.48), close to impact_sum +0.70.

findings.finding: The H1 plan implies Q2 経常 of 2,482m (6,390 less 3,908), 36% below Q1, while Q1 orders were 99,775m (book-to-bill 1.65), the backlog was 185,609m (+57.4% YoY) and H2 was explicitly left at the initial 7,210m. So the H1 plan beat is near-certain, and so is the full-year raise the company promised to make 'promptly' if needed; it has revised FY 経常 at the Q2 print in 4 of the last 5 years. A 40% payout target also mechanically lifts the interim dividend above 60 yen on a net-profit beat, as it did at the FY3/24 Q2 print (46.67 to 61). The surprise against IFIS 14,200m needs FY above roughly 14.2-14.3bn, i.e. an H1 above 7.1bn plus at least an unchanged H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY3/27 (2026-07-29, H1 経常 raised 56%, FY raised 20%, dividend +21 yen) gave +8.07% the next day (kabutan 2026-07-30: 大幅反発). Q2 FY3/26 (2025-10-29, FY 経常 cut 9%, dividend +3 yen) gave -1.75% (estimated date). Q2 FY3/25 (FY held) gave +3.61% (estimated date).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. IFIS sits 600m above the company FY plan and 710m above its H1 plan, so the H1 beat is in the price; that is why this is sized at +1.0 and not near the +8% Q1 reaction. What the market does not have is whether H2 gets raised as well. If it had priced an H2 raise, the consensus would sit well above plan plus the H1 beat; instead consensus H2 (7,100m) sits below the company's own unchanged 7,210m.

That is industry demand, not TED's own number. Revision history: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2760

findings.finding: The company itself attributes part of the order surge to customers ordering ahead (先行手配) on worries about AI-driven lead-time stretch and price rises. That makes an H2 payback plausible and a cautious H2 at this print likely, which caps the FY raise near the consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print isolates this line. The FY3/26 Q2 cut (a cautious guide) gave -1.75% (estimated).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The wording has been public for three months and the consensus H2 below plan already reflects some caution. What is left is the chance the company says outright that pull-forward is reversing.
findings.independence: Same company filing set as finding 1 (the 2026-07-29 revision notice and 短信), so it is not independent. It is filed separately because it bears on H2, not on H1.

baseline_tension: The positive lean cuts mildly against priced_lean (-0.75, mostly margin overhang and run-up). The strongest positive is a FY raise above 14.2bn plus a higher interim dividend, and I looked for it. The strongest negative is a FY raised only by the H1 beat, which already sits in consensus, plus a pull-forward warning on H2; that outcome reads flat-to-down on a stock 22% above its 200-day line. Both are plausible, hence p_up 56.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the pull-forward finding rests on a three-month-old public 短信, so it shrank from -0.5 to -0.3 and its weight in p_up fell (55 to 56)
Rule 2 (check the sign): there was only one small negative; the strongest positive and the search for it are recorded in baseline_tension. Finding 1 unchanged.
